summary: MaterialDNA treats installation.seamPeriodMeters as optional and validates it only when present, while its already-known wallpaper/carpet compatibility rules select installation methods whose shipped ordinary fixtures carry explicit regular seam periods. Removing only seamPeriodMeters from an otherwise-valid known wallpaper or compatible carpet recipe remains canonical, but the contract never defines whether nil means seam-free, unresolved, representation-owned, or adapter-defaulted.
evidence: Current src/shared/Materials/MaterialDNA.luau validateInstallation() calls validatePositive(... seamPeriodMeters ...) only when the field is non-nil; validateCompatibility() then constrains known wallpaper/carpet installation methods without adding any seam-period predicate.

Current MaterialFixtureCatalog authors installation.pasted-wallpaper with seamPeriodMeters=0.53 and installation.glued-carpet-roll with seamPeriodMeters=3.6576, while factory-coated painted metal omits the field, demonstrating method/family-specific intended use rather than a universally required scalar.
Current Docs/MATERIAL_DNA_CONTRACT.md describes installation/batch and bounded validation but does not define the canonical meaning of a nil seamPeriodMeters value.

Repository issue/PR searches for seamPeriodMeters returned no dedicated existing owner; this is separate from repairCount exactness, bounded-validator diagnostics, percent key grammar, hostile-key/fixture-drift, and known visual/physical/acoustic family coherence work.
PR #488 records the exact source-derived repro and bounded follow-up; one docs file only, with no local Luau, Studio, viewport, networking, persistence, or physical-contact execution claim.

metadata.recommendedNext: After current higher-priority MaterialDNA validator lineage is integrated, explicitly define nil seam-period semantics. If known seamed installation methods own regular seam spacing canonically, require an explicit positive seam period for those methods only and add deterministic missing/present regressions; do not infer the rule from key string prefixes or require seams for every installation method.
